company_overview: Postman is an API platform for building and using APIs. Postman simplifies each step of the API lifecycle and streamlines collaboration so you can create better APIs—faster.
target_audience: Engineers and development teams who build, test, manage, and distribute APIs and services.

company_overview: Supabase provides an open‑source Postgres‑based developer platform that adds authentication, realtime, storage, edge functions, and vector search to simplify building full‑stack applications. It delivers instant REST and GraphQL APIs, scalable infrastructure, and enterprise‑grade security features for developers and innovation teams.
target_audience: Developers building full‑stack web or mobile applications who need a managed Postgres backend with built‑in auth, realtime, storage, and API generation.

company_overview: Vapi provides a unified platform for building, testing, deploying, and monitoring voice agents with enterprise‑grade infrastructure, AI guardrails and compliance. It enables enterprises to launch scalable voice conversational experiences quickly, with real‑time analytics, SSO, and dedicated support.
target_audience: Enterprises and developers building voice agents and conversational AI solutions at scale
